entities.title: Example suites
entities.summary: The library's worked examples, as unit tests: the UTV-first and native-first suites and the fixture they share.
entities.purpose: Holds the two example suites of docs/example-tests.md in utv_first/ and native_first/, and fixtures.py, whose demo_zone_rules() loads conformance/rules/demo-zones.json from the repository root for every UTV zone operation in them. test_fixtures.py tests that fixture.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in its own folder's verification.json.
There are no example programs: every example runs with the library's tests.
